verses.text: A Psalm for Thanksgiving. Shout joyfully to the LORD, all the earth.
verses.textZh: （稱謝詩。）普天下當向耶和華歡呼！

verses.text: Serve the LORD with gladness; Come before Him with joyful singing.
verses.textZh: 你們當樂意事奉耶和華，當來向他歌唱！

verses.text: Know that the LORD Himself is God; It is He who has made us, and not we ourselves; [We are] His people and the sheep of His pasture.
verses.textZh: 你們當曉得耶和華是神！我們是他造的，也是屬他的；我們是他的民，也是他草場的羊。

verses.text: Enter His gates with thanksgiving [And] His courts with praise. Give thanks to Him, bless His name.
verses.textZh: 當稱謝進入他的門；當讚美進入他的院。當感謝他，稱頌他的名！

verses.text: For the LORD is good; His lovingkindness is everlasting And His faithfulness to all generations.
verses.textZh: 因為耶和華本為善。他的慈愛存到永遠；他的信實直到萬代。
